verses.12:12: أَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعَنَا غَدࣰ ا يَرۡتَعۡ وَيَلۡعَبۡ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

meaning: The root رتع (rtE) primarily describes animals grazing freely and abundantly. Metaphorically, it extends to humans enjoying plentiful food and drink, or acting freely.
